newsitem.title: GERMANY: German banks to loan Kirch 1.5 bln dmk - magazine.
newsitem.headline: German banks to loan Kirch 1.5 bln dmk - magazine.

text.p: A German banking consortium led by Commerzbank AG is ready to loan 1.5 billion marks to Bavarian media group Kirch Gruppe, newsmagazine Der Spiegel reported at the weekend.
A Commerzbank spokesman said he could not comment on the report. A spokesman for Kirch said the group never commented on its relations with banks.

In this week's edition, Spiegel said Commerzbank would loan 500 million marks to Kirch. Other banks included in the pool were identified as Dresdner Bank, BHF Bank, Bayerische Landesbank and Bayerische Vereinsbank.
